reason: A Composer-integrated dictation plugin that captures speech, transcribes it via Web Speech or an optional localhost SenseVoice service, optionally polishes it with session context, and can submit it only when the user enables automatic sending.

summaries.zh: 在 Composer 中提供上下文感知的语音听写，将麦克风输入转为可编辑文字，并可选择本地转写、模型润色和用户授权后的自动发送。
summaries.en: Adds context-aware dictation to Composer by converting microphone input into editable text with optional local transcription, model polishing, and user-authorized automatic sending.

capabilities: Captures microphone audio with user permission
Transcribes speech through browser Web Speech or a user-configured localhost endpoint
Optionally sends transcription and limited session context to a selected model for polishing
Can optionally submit transcription automatically after the user stops recording
Can start, stop, and check a locally configured transcription service
